  WHY: The log tails show only PASS lines and the error output of negative tests that fail on purpose. The cause has not been found: reviewers suspect either the 20-minute timeout at line 2529 or content merged from orchestrator/project-8291 at feb0f3e6b157. The editor needs the full failed-job logs, a local run of the group-0/group-2 slices, or a run on the base feb0f3e6b157. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it MAJOR with confidence 2; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it BLOCKER. minimax_minimax-m3 gave an advisory note only, saying the failure comes from the project-8291 merge and is out of scope.

  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run added `ai:waiting-on-dependency` to the `PHASE_LABELS` tuple in scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py, but the `files_touched` grant of linked issue #8880 does not include that file.
  WHY: The scope guard (`tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py`, which the pre-push gate lists as a failure caused by this change) rejects script edits outside the grant, so the gate stays red. The editor must either revert the one-line edit or deliberately widen the grant.

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: The test enforces a strict list of allowed phase labels, so adding the label without updating the test makes it fail. Three reviewers dispute this: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash cite scripts/label_helpers.sh:51/119/159 and scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:106 as registering the label, and minimax_minimax-m3 says the test name was hallucinated.

  WHY: The schema mismatch causes a `jq` error (exit status 3) in the filter, so the test fails. Three reviewers dispute this: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash cite scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3153-3164 as supplying both values via `--argjson` and using them in the filter.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:orchestrate-poll job, lines 2496-2529 (matrix poll-group 0-4, timeout-minutes: 20). Failed check-runs: "orchestrate-poll (0)" (job 129753336647) and "orchestrate-poll (2)" (job 129753336670) in run 42793709184 on head ac5a142055fb. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both poller matrix groups fail on the merged head and the lint aggregate reports "CI jobs that did not succeed: orchestrate-poll". The reviewer could not link the failure to this PR: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py lines 30872-30949 write the _PPV_STUB_HELPER stub instead of running the real script, the test file never mentions dependency_wait_resume.py or stage_support_for_phase.sh, and the log tails contain only PASS lines and expected negative-test output. The cause is either a 20-minute timeout or content merged from orchestrator/project-8291 at feb0f3e6b157. This is the third failing head in a row.
  WHY: Lint stays red. Before editing code, the editor needs the full failed-job logs, or a run of the same shards on base feb0f3e6b157.
- Rejected pass-1 claims (3 related items):
  - The gemini claim about the freeze-filter test is wrong: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3153-3164 passes --argjson blocker_runs and blocker_paths and uses them in the filter.
  - The gemini claim that ai:waiting-on-dependency is unregistered is wrong: scripts/label_helpers.sh lines 51, 119 and 159 carry the label, and scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py PHASE_LABELS matches that list.
  - The --ignore-fences fix is correct: plan.yml lines 2196-2198 strip only closed fences, and the DEP_WAIT_RAW scan at lines 2217-2219 has no fence toggle.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. Every deliverable in the grant is in the diff. The gemini "make all failing tests pass" gap is not a requirement in the linked issue.
- HARDENING: scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py park(), the branch `if not gh.add_labels(issue_number, [WAIT_LABEL]): return "label_failed"`
  PROBLEM: The AI_DEPENDENCY_WAIT_V1 marker is already posted when the label write fails and the handler falls back to ai:blocked. The marker stays with that run's `since`, so if someone later swaps in the wait label by hand, the escalation clock starts from the old date.
  FIX: In that branch, write one stderr line through _park_log("park", issue_number, target_label(wait), phase, "label_failed", "marker_posted"). Estimated lines changed: 2. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

A later manual swap back to the wait label would make the P8b scan read a stale `since`. The comment text also says the issue is parked in `ai:waiting-on-dependency` while the label is actually `ai:blocked`, which can mislead a human operator.
  FIX: Edit the posted comment to record the failure, or at least log `_park_log("park", ..., detail="marker_posted_label_failed")`. Estimated lines changed: 2-3. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Advisory (not a finding): orchestrate-poll (0) and (2) fail on head ac5a142055fb (run 42793709184, jobs 129753336647 and 129753336670) and on the two prior heads (runs 42777788862, 42787736243). The reviewer says the failures come from the merge of orchestrator/project-8291, not from the LAST RUN DIFF, and are out of scope for this review. Attributing them needs the full failed-job logs or a local reproduction.
